title: Stock Market & Trading
tagline: NEPSE data, IPO automation, and capital-market tools
description: NEPSE itself does not publish a documented public API — paid feeds run NPR 10k–60k/month. The community has built a thriving ecosystem of unofficial wrappers, scrapers, and IPO bots. The basic-bgnr/NepseUnofficialApi library is foundational; surajrimal07's REST+WebSocket+MCP service is the most feature-rich.

resources.name: NEPSE Official
resources.description: Official Nepal Stock Exchange site. JSON endpoints exist but are not documented as a public API; SSL chain incomplete (use verify_ssl=False if scraping).
resources.note: No documented public API; paid feeds NPR 10k–60k/month. [Automated] Link appears to be broken or unreachable.

resources.name: basic-bgnr/NepseUnofficialApi
resources.description: Foundational Python library that deciphers NEPSE's WASM-protected auth key. The lib most other NEPSE projects depend on.

resources.name: surajrimal07/NepseAPI-Unofficial
resources.description: Most feature-rich NEPSE wrapper: REST + WebSocket + first MCP server (Claude). Free hosted at nepseapi.surajrimal.dev / wss://nepseapiws.surajrimal.dev.

resources.name: q-viper/NEPSE-Data-Analysis
resources.description: Data analysis + LSTM forecasting on NEPSE 2000–2018 dataset.

resources.name: Mero Share (CDSC)
resources.description: Official IPO/dividend platform run by CDS & Clearing. Mobile API CORS-restricted since ~2023.

resources.name: bipin0x01/meroshare-bot
resources.description: IPO application automation for Mero Share.
resources.note: Use only with your own credentials; respect CDSC ToS.

resources.name: Nepse Alpha
resources.description: Free TradingView-style charts and analytics for NEPSE.

resources.name: ShareHub Nepal
resources.description: Modern NEPSE charts, watchlists, portfolio tracking.
